parsed.note_claim: The building shown on the back of the $20 bill is the North Portico of the White House, not the East Wing.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: The North Portico is the covered entrance to The White House. Constructed as the public entrance, this is where the president and first lady traditionally greet arriving guests.
parsed.reason: The page describes the North Portico as the White House's covered entrance and shows the north view, but it never mentions the $20 bill or the East Wing, so it only indirectly supports the note.
